name: Nature walks: plants, birds & trees (AI-written, not yet reviewed)
description: 42 questions on what you see on a nature walk: plants, birds and trees (6 very easy, 12 easy, 12 medium, 12 hard), written by Claude on 2026-10-06; the very easy ones are marked easy with a note "very easy" until the very easy level lands. The independent fact-check kept 42 of 44 written, fixed 12 and deleted 2. Every question and answer needs checking by a person before anybody plays it.

source.name: Written by hand by Claude Code (claude-opus-5-5, Anthropic) on 2026-10-06, from its own knowledge plus the pages each item cites: no API call. 37 items cite a page the writing pass fetched on 2026-10-06 and quote the phrase on it that supports the fact; 5 rest on "common knowledge" (genuinely universal everyday facts), each with the reason. Then fact-checked item by item by a separate Claude pass on 2026-10-06 that did not write them (every cited page re-fetched and read for the fact, every answer, wrong answer, explanation and level checked; `checked` keeps who checked it and what was fixed; items that could not be made right, and duplicates of other packs, were deleted). Very easy items are marked difficulty "easy" with "note": "very easy" until the very easy level lands. A person still reviews it by playing.

review.how: Check every question, answer and explanation. Fix or delete what is wrong, set status to 'reviewed' with your name and the date, then move the file to packs/ and list it in pack_library.js.

items.question: Acorns grow on which kind of tree?
